title: Released a big update to my idle ARPG.
author: PulIthEld

comments.author: PulIthEld
comments.body:
This update was about getting the game to feel good.  I did a lot of iterations of play testing with multiple claude agents using the chrome extension so they could play like normal people.  

While that caught a lot of issues, i still had to playtest myself to get the feeling more correct.  AI can say it all technically works, but you will pick up on details it misses.

Designing the loot and resource sinks and upgrades to all be cohesive is harder than it seems!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/PulIthEld please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

replies.author: PulIthEld
replies.body: I posted a comment about play testing with AI and tried to explain a bit about that process.
